messages:
sara: Heads up — planned maintenance tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC (az3-rack-7). Soft-drain + NIC fw + KV cache preheat. Low traffic window. Details below.
neil: ETA for full backfill? will we lose capacity for priority tenants?
sara: target 02:00 start, expected 45–60m. We'll soft-drain GPUs in cohorts of 4 per rack to keep >= 60% capacity. Priority tenants moved to 'swan' pool.
toni: pls tag jobs with billing: cc=infra-maint-2026
jamie: customer demo at 02:15 — can we skip their instances? @sara
sara: yes — add tenant id to allowlist in the drain script. Ping me the id.
ops-bot: automated: maintenance scheduled for 6143210000 (az3-rack-7). Canary will run 15m after start. Alerts to #incidents if p95 latency > 200ms.
sara: KV cache preheat plan: run preheat shards 0..15, parallelism 8, rate-limit 200qps. This writes warm entries to prefix cache to avoid cold-token spikes. Expected extra tx: ~3M tokens, ~ $120 ops cost.
neil: what's fallback if warm cache job fails? roll back to canary? degrade to quantized model?
sara: fallback order: 1) divert latency-sensitive traffic to 'swan' dedicated pool (lower throughput but warmed), 2) switch to gpt-small-q4 for non-critical requests, 3) if NVLink issues, abort and roll back fw.
jamie: will observability show per-tenant token cost realtime?
ops-bot: dashboards updated: /console/dashboards/kv-preheat, per-tenant cost panels live. We'll auto-open incident if error-rate > 1% for 5m.
sara: Runbook snippets — drain command and allowlist:
```
# soft drain cohort
kubectl cordon node-az3-rack7-cohort-$COHORT
kubectl drain node-az3-rack7-cohort-$COHORT --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
# allowlist
./drain-tool --allowlist tenant-123,tenant-456 --tag cc=infra-maint-2026
```
toni: I'll push the billing tag and notify finance.
finance-bot: estimated one-time infra cost ~$150 (preheat + backfill). Charge to infra ops Q1. Approve.
sara: ok proceeding. @jamie add tenant id by EOD or we'll exclude by default. ops: please stand by at 01:45 UTC.
neil: ack. I'll watch capacity and canary metrics.
jamie: sending id now — tenant-789
sara: got it. thanks, everyone. :thumbsup:
